company.name: Py
company.shortDescription: Py is a mobile app that offers users to learn app development and data science skills online.
company.description:
Py is a learn-to-code mobile app that provides courses, including Javascript, Swift, Python, and HTML/CSS. Aside from that, Py also covers a broad a variety of subjects, including humanities, sciences, and even courses like English grammar.

The learn-to-code space is changing the learning experience by providing different creative approaches to inspire learners of all ages from board games to programmable robots to gamified learning platforms.

Py was founded in 2016 and is based in San Francisco, California. In 2019, Py was acquired by Hired, a career marketplace that matches tech talent with innovative companies.
